name: Mountain Pro 滑雪外套（女款）
description:
The North Face Mountain Pro 女款滑雪外套，全季节都能穿。150D FUTURELIGHT™ 3L 防水透气面料，耐磨。尺码 S。

## 面料与科技
- FUTURELIGHT™ 3L 三层防水透气面料，150 旦尼尔，耐磨

## 设计细节
- 标准版型
- 右胸 ID 卡透明窗
- 口袋周围和背后有反光条
- 左胸口袋带对讲机挂环
- 连帽可调节，不可拆
- 腋下透气拉链
descriptionEn:
The North Face Mountain Pro women's jacket, built for all-season use in durable, waterproof and breathable 150-denier FUTURELIGHT™ 3L fabric. Size S.

## Fabric & Tech
- FUTURELIGHT™ 3L waterproof, breathable fabric, 150 denier and durable

## Design Details
- Standard fit
- ID window on the right chest
- Reflective tape around the pockets and a reflective strip on the back
- Left chest pocket with a radio loop
- Attached, adjustable hood
- Pit-zip vents
